quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Concealed"? (a hidden treasure buried under sand vs. a chest sitting wide open on the beach)
quests.hint: Think about how a magician keeps a card until the big reveal. What's the opposite of "Concealed"?
quests.explanation: "Concealed" means kept hidden from view. "Exposed" means left out in plain view. Since those are completely different, Exposed is the opposite of Concealed!
quests.funFact: exposed is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Crowded"? (a beach packed shoulder to shoulder vs. a beach with not a single footprint)
quests.hint: Think about how a mall looks the week before a holiday versus right at sunrise. What's the opposite of "Crowded"?
quests.explanation: "Crowded" means full of many people, with little space. "Deserted" means empty, with no people around at all. Since those are completely different, Deserted is the opposite of Crowded!
quests.funFact: deserted is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Independent"? (a kid making their own breakfast solo vs. a kid who needs help with every step)
quests.hint: Think about tying your own shoes without asking for help. What's the opposite of "Independent"?
quests.explanation: "Independent" means able to do things by yourself. "Dependent" means needing someone else's help to do things. Since those are completely different, Dependent is the opposite of Independent!
quests.funFact: dependent is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Renewable"? (sunlight beaming down endlessly vs. coal that took millions of years to form)
quests.hint: Think about the energy source that keeps shining every single day for free. What's the opposite of "Renewable"?
quests.explanation: "Renewable" means able to be used again and again, like sunlight. "Nonrenewable" means limited, because it can't be replaced quickly. Since those are completely different, Nonrenewable is the opposite of Renewable!
quests.funFact: nonrenewable is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Considerate"? (holding the door open for someone with full hands vs. letting a door slam in their face)
quests.hint: Think about what you'd do if you noticed a classmate forgot their lunch. What's the opposite of "Considerate"?
quests.explanation: "Considerate" means thinking of other people's feelings and needs. "Thoughtless" means not thinking of other people's feelings and needs. Since those are completely different, Thoughtless is the opposite of Considerate!
quests.funFact: thoughtless is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Global"? (a company with stores on every continent vs. a single shop in one small town)
quests.hint: Think about the difference between a worldwide chain and the corner bakery. What's the opposite of "Global"?
quests.explanation: "Global" means covering the whole world. "Local" means limited to one nearby area. Since those are completely different, Local is the opposite of Global!
quests.funFact: local is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Formal"? (a tuxedo at a fancy wedding vs. comfy pajamas on a lazy Saturday)

quests.explanation: "Formal" means proper and following strict rules of style. "Informal" means relaxed and casual, without strict rules. Since those are completely different, Informal is the opposite of Formal!
quests.funFact: informal is an interesting opposite word!

quests.funFact: timid is an interesting opposite word!
